product.title: The Original Amsterdam City Highlights Bike Tour (EN/NL/DE)

description.text: Enjoy an alternative sightseeing circuit of Amsterdam on a bike tour through waterways and cobbled streets. A professional guide leads past Centraal Station, Prinseneiland, the Jordaan, Anne Frank House, Westertoren, and Vondelpark, covering history and local coffee-shop culture. Groups stay small so the ride can leave the packed tourist circuit. Bike provision and canal-path routing stay with the guide so visitors can cycle rather than rent independently. Stops include Centraal Station, Prinseneiland, The Jordaan, Anne Frank House, Westertoren, Vondelpark.
